nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Serves as the chapter roadmap and table of contents for Chapter 2, outlining the four-step setup sequence from prerequisites to gateway acceptance testing.
nodes.languageNotes: Markdown chapter landing page outlining learning goals and platform scope across macOS, Linux, and Windows WSL2.

nodes.name: 2.1_requirements.md
nodes.summary: Specifies hardware, Node.js runtime, network connectivity, and API credential prerequisites for deploying OpenClaw.
nodes.languageNotes: Highlights the strict requirement for Node 24.16+ or Node 26.1+ due to node:sqlite NUL byte truncation defects in older releases.

nodes.name: 2.2_installation.md
nodes.summary: Guides users through OpenClaw installation using the one-line install script, npm, Docker, and source builds, alongside environment variable and path configurations.
nodes.languageNotes: Details platform-specific shell setup, WSL2 network routing boundaries, and reversible upgrade workflows.

nodes.name: 2.3_onboarding.md
nodes.summary: Explains how to run the interactive onboarding wizard to configure models, workspaces, and daemons while defining workspace bootstrap file roles.
nodes.languageNotes: Clarifies workspace lifecycle files including AGENTS.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, SOUL.md, and heartbeat routines.

nodes.name: 2.4_gateway_service.md
nodes.summary: Details OpenClaw Gateway daemon management, local health acceptance testing checklists, and layered troubleshooting architectures.
nodes.languageNotes: Outlines a four-tier diagnostic decision tree spanning environment, control plane, execution chain, and remote API networking.

nodes.name: summary.md
nodes.summary: Reviews key setup takeaways, provides a post-installation security and operational checklist, and previews Chapter 3 minimal loop topics.
